title: Breviary
html_source: The Roman Breviary, used throughout the Latin Church, is divided into four parts according to the seasons of the year: Winter, Spring, Summer, and Autumn. It contains all the daily psalms, hymns, prayers, lessons, etc., necessary for reciting the office.
